description: Scenario selection dialog in its idle state (base view): the list of maps on the left, map properties panel on the right. No popup visible. Establishes the baseline layout before any right-click.
Right-clicking on the Players Icon column correctly shows the Players Icon tooltip. This is the expected correct behavior for icon-area right-clicks.
Scenario selection dialog idle state again, showing a different map selected. Demonstrates the selection works normally; the right-click issue is independent of which map is highlighted.
Right-clicking on an icon area triggers the wrong file-location/map-type popup dialog instead of that icon's own tooltip.
Scenario selection dialog idle state, third variation. The properties panel on the right shows map metadata (name, size, difficulty) correctly in idle mode.

Byte-identical to bug_4.png and bug_8.png -- the original bug report reused the same capture for this step. Still documents the wrong file-location/map-type popup appearing on an icon-area right-click; does not independently confirm a different icon column.
Scenario selection dialog idle state, fourth variation. Confirms the normal layout is intact between right-click attempts.
